description: The bar chart depicts performance gain (in percent) for three models under two supervision settings, illustrating how “Strong Supervision” and “Weak Supervision” are represented for each model. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model names “GPT-4o,” “Claude-3.5-Sonnet,” and “Qwen2-72B-VL,” shown left to right, while the vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (+%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 30 with tick marks at regular 5-point intervals. For each model, two adjacent bars are shown: the “Strong Supervision” bar is medium blue with diagonal hatch marks, and the “Weak Supervision” bar is a lighter solid blue, as indicated by the legend at the top. For GPT-4o, the strong-supervision bar reaches roughly 24–25%, and the weak-supervision bar is around 5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the strong-supervision bar is near 9–10% and the weak-supervision bar is about 3–4%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the strong-supervision bar is approximately 15% and the weak-supervision bar is around 5%. The bars are presented as grouped pairs per model without stacking, and there is no additional visual emphasis beyond the consistent color and hatch styling; the categories do not appear to be sorted by value.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (+%) achieved under strong and weak supervision for different models. The horizontal axis contains categories labeled as 'GPT-4o', 'Claude-3.5-Sonnet', and 'Qwen2-72B-VL', arranged in no particular order. The vertical axis represents 'Performance Gain (+%)', with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked at intervals of 5 percent. For 'GPT-4o', the strong supervision bar reaches approximately 20%, while the weak supervision bar is around 8%. For 'Claude-3.5-Sonnet,' the strong supervision bar is about 12%, and the weak supervision bar is close to 6%. For 'Qwen2-72B-VL', the strong supervision bar measures approximately 18%, and the weak supervision bar is around 7%. The bars are neither sorted in a specific numeric order nor visually emphasized with any additional shading or outlines, beyond their consistent format. A legend is available on top of the plot to map different styles of bar to their group ('Strong Supervision' and 'Weak Supervision').
